messages:
Nina Patel: quick q — promoted an IC -> M4 in eng, effective 2026-02-01. Manager says packet submitted but asking what actually counts as ‘evidence’ for leveling. also the employee is in India so we need guidance on currency for the salary change + retro pay. what should i tell the manager?
Jamal Ortiz: thanks nina — short answer: use the Promo Evidence form and attach specific examples. more detail: 2 manager bullets (scope + org impact), before/after job summary, 1-page writeup with 2–3 concrete project examples and metrics. link: https://docs.redwood/promo-evidence (internal). for APAC comp: file the comp-change in Workday and pick local currency (INR). cc payroll in the ticket.
Priya Singh: can the "1-page writeup" be a bulleted list with 3 examples (no long narrative)? also what's our typical retro pay window so i can tell finance what to expect? manager needs numbers to budget.
Jamal Ortiz: yep bullets are fine — keep it focused: what they owned before, what they own now, concrete impact (revenue/latency/ops saved/etc). retro policy: if comp-change ticket hits payroll before cutoff we process retro to the effective date; otherwise it goes next payroll. if retro exceeds 90 days or is > $10k we escalate to finance lead for approval.
Michael Bauer: adding finance context: payroll will compute retro using the approved effective date. FX for INR: we convert on the effective date using payroll's conversion table. payroll cutoff is the 15th of each month for next-month pay cycles (exceptions for local country payrolls). please include base, target bonus %, equity schedule in the comp-change ticket so payroll can calculate tax withholding correctly.
Priya Singh: who owns getting the tax docs / local paperwork? employee or manager? and how do we surface the converted amounts so manager can budget in USD?
Michael Bauer: payroll needs the employee to sign/local tax forms — manager should nudge them to submit via Workday onboarding. for budgeting: include both amounts in the ticket (USD equivalent and INR). finance will add the FX rate used in the approval email.
Jamal Ortiz: quick checklist manager can follow:
```
- Fill Promo Evidence form (attach 1-page bullets + 2 manager statements)
- Submit comp-change ticket in Workday, set currency = INR and include USD equivalent
- Attach org chart + before/after job summary
- Tag @people-payroll and @finance in the ticket
- If retro > 90 days or > $10k, add "Finance Escalation" label
```
Jamal Ortiz: also note: for leveling rationale we need to tie examples to rubric axes (ownership, technical breadth, influence). we rarely accept only peer kudos; need measurable outcomes.
people-bot: Promo Evidence form submitted (ticket #C-7890). Payroll notified :white_check_mark:
Nina Patel: awesome, i’ll forward this thread to the manager and ask them to attach the 1-pager + comp numbers today. thanks everyone! :pray:
Priya Singh: thanks team — i'll update the manager and action items now.
Michael Bauer: ping me if the retro looks large and i'll pre-authorize escalation.
Jamal Ortiz: if you want the template i can drop a Google doc in #people-ops resources in 5m.
Nina Patel: perfect — appreciate it.
